tools.name: get_habitation_leak_search
tools.description: Public, read-only documentary example: search for leaks versus repair of the pipe in home-insurance archival documents. Returns only previously publishable fact IDs with formula scope, document version and evidence IDs, or abstains. It never confirms current availability, personalized coverage, rank

tools.name: get_ai_sources
tools.description: Returns the AssurancesLabs citation-oriented sources map (same payload as GET /api/ai/sources).

tools.name: resolve_quote_intent
tools.description: Maps an insurance type to the canonical questionnaire deep link and required fields (same as POST /api/ai/quote-intent).
